en.name: Garlic Sweet Potato Leaves, Rice-Cooker Steamed

items: If unsure whether the leaves are organic, soak them under running water for 15–20 minutes, then wash leaf by leaf.
Peel the outer skin off the thicker stems — this makes them more tender and much nicer to eat.
Place the leaves in the inner pot and add a drizzle of oil — steaming with a little oil removes the astringency.
Add half a cup of water to the rice cooker's outer pot and steam. As soon as the switch pops up, take the leaves out — leaving them to sit will turn the greens black.
Mince the garlic, add it with the soy paste, and toss everything together to serve.
不確定是否為有機地瓜葉時，可用流動清水浸泡 15～20 分鐘，再一片一片洗乾淨。
挑揀時把較粗的梗外皮去除，這樣吃起來會比較嫩，口感更好。
將地瓜葉放入內鍋，淋上適量的油——加一點油一起蒸可去除澀味。
電鍋外鍋加入半杯水蒸煮，開關跳起後要馬上取出，悶著葉菜會黑掉。
將蒜頭切碎，與醬油膏一起加入拌勻即可享用。
